models_evaluated: AI-enabled ECG (AI-ECG) mortality risk alert system

links.outcome: 90-day all-cause mortality and cost-effectiveness of AI-ECG alerts versus usual care in randomized trial
links.effect: 90-day mortality 3.6% intervention vs 4.3% control; overall cost similar ($6204 vs $5803); ICER $59,500 per death averted (95% CI: $-4657 to $385,950).
links.quote: Among 15,965 patients, 90-day all-cause mortality was 3.6% in the intervention group versus 4.3% in controls.

unlisted_practices: Health-payer cost-effectiveness (ICER per death averted) analysis of a deployed AI alert system

screen.reason: Economic evaluation of a pragmatic randomized trial testing an AI-ECG alert system that pushes reports/alerts to physicians for patients at high risk of mortality.
